Since the canoe can only hold 5 bags of trash at a time, Alicia must take multiple trips to the shore to dispose of all 23 bags. Dividing 23 bags by 5 bags per trip, we get 4 trips with 3 bags left over. Alicia must take one more trip to dispose of the remaining 3 bags. So the total number of trips she must take is 4 + 1 = 5. A screw by definition is not a bolt. A bolt passes through a hole of a larger diameter than its thread and is held in place by a nut or similar device. It is not designed to be turned.
